phase_1.title: Phase 1 · FN 5.7 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.7×28mm NATO (SS190 / SS197SR) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 345 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 345 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 122 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 8-groove bore and accelerates to 650 m/s (425 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Lever Retardation & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, unequal-arm delay lever multiplies carrier inertia to hold breech lockup during peak chamber pressure.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the FN 5.7 staged for its 65 RPM (low-recoil rapid semi-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪：1998 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 作为 FN P90 的孪生伴侣手枪，比利时 FN Five-seveN 采用独树一帜的“凸轮杠杆延迟反冲”机构与聚合物包覆轻质钢套筒：空重仅 610 克却容纳 20 发 5.7×28mm 尖头微口径步枪式手枪弹，后坐力比 9mm 降低 30% 以上。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：FN 5.7 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1998 年问世的 比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪 由比利时比利时国营赫斯塔尔公司（FN Herstal）主导研制，定位为经典的杠杆延迟反冲小口径高速手枪。Five-seveN 名称中大写的 “F” 与 “N” 暗藏制造商 FN Herstal 的品牌徽记，目前已列装全球逾 40 个国家的反恐与政要护卫单位。
作为 FN P90 的孪生伴侣手枪，比利时 FN Five-seveN 采用独树一帜的“凸轮杠杆延迟反冲”机构与聚合物包覆轻质钢套筒：空重仅 610 克却容纳 20 发 5.7×28mm 尖头微口径步枪式手枪弹，后坐力比 9mm 降低 30% 以上。 整件装备总长 208 mm（8.2 in）、空重 0.61 kg，成为同期手枪左轮领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1998 年，比利时比利时国营赫斯塔尔公司（FN Herstal）推出了划时代的比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪。Five-seveN 名称中大写的 “F” 与 “N” 暗藏制造商 FN Herstal 的品牌徽记，目前已列装全球逾 40 个国家的反恐与政要护卫单位。 它的核心设计聚焦于独创凸轮摇臂杠杆延迟反冲机构，仅靠 3 mm 枪管直移即可泄压安全开锁，奠定了其在手枪左轮发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 精密铣削往复式钢制套筒

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪 的机械灵魂在于其「摇臂杠杆延迟反冲闭锁 · 聚合物包覆钢套筒 · 20 发高容弹匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，不等臂延迟杠杆放大机框惯性阻力，延缓弹壳初抽直至膛压跌入安全窗口，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。内钢外塑复合包覆套筒将整枪空重压缩至惊人的 610 克且防腐耐候，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪 采用摇臂杠杆延迟反冲闭锁 · 聚合物包覆钢套筒 · 20 发高容弹匣。在每个击发周期中，不等臂延迟杠杆放大机框惯性阻力，延缓弹壳初抽直至膛压跌入安全窗口。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了内钢外塑复合包覆套筒将整枪空重压缩至惊人的 610 克且防腐耐候。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.7×28mm NATO (SS190 / SS197SR) 弹药规格与 122 mm（4.8 in 镀铬冷锻枪管 · 8 条右旋 · 1:231 mm），最高工作膛压约 345 MPa，可赋予弹头 650 m/s 的出膛初速与 425 J 动能，有效作用距离达 50 米。
内膛技术特点方面，122 mm 8 条右旋镀铬高速步枪型膛线，稳定 650 m/s 尖头瓶口微口径弹头。同时，与 P90 共用 5.7×28mm 高初速尖头瓶口弹，标准齐平弹匣即装 20 发，令其在 65 发/分（超低后坐速射） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 122 毫米身管与 5.7×28mm NATO (SS190 / SS197SR) 口径，比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪 实现了每秒 650 米的初速与 50 米有效射程。122 mm 8 条右旋镀铬高速步枪型膛线，稳定 650 m/s 尖头瓶口微口径弹头，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 32 mm 膛轴设计，比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 1.7 N·s 水平。扳机上方对称食指保险杆配合内藏击锤实现清脆轻盈的单动击发手感。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-88）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，扳机上方对称食指保险杆配合内藏击锤实现清脆轻盈的单动击发手感。欢迎在 BAY-88 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 比利时 FN Five-seveN Mk2 穿甲手枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the FN 5.7
paragraphs: Introduced in 1998 by FN Herstal in Belgium, the FN Five-seveN Mk2 Pistol emerged as a defining Lever-Delayed 5.7×28mm Service Pistol. Capitalizing “F” and “N” in Five-seveN as a nod to FN Herstal, the 5.7mm pistol has been adopted by counter-terror and protective security units in over 40 nations.

Developed as the companion sidearm to the FN P90, the Belgian Five-seveN utilizes a unique cam-lever delayed blowback system inside a polymer-shrouded steel slide, packing 20 flat-shooting 5.7×28mm rounds into an ultralight 610 g pistol with 30% less recoil than 9mm. Measuring 208 mm (8.2 in) at an unloaded weight of 0.61 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Handgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1998, FN Herstal of Belgium introduced the FN Five-seveN Mk2 Pistol. Capitalizing “F” and “N” in Five-seveN as a nod to FN Herstal, the 5.7mm pistol has been adopted by counter-terror and protective security units in over 40 nations. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Unique cam-lever delayed blowback allows straight-line 3 mm barrel travel before unlocking — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the FN Five-seveN Mk2 Pistol sits its Cam-Lever Delayed Blowback · Polymer-Shrouded Steel Slide · 20-Round Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, unequal-arm delay lever multiplies carrier inertia to hold breech lockup during peak chamber pressure, containing 345 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Polymer-shrouded steel slide trims empty mass to 610 g while resisting corrosion, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
